target.title: Feature/Fix: Adapt rollout snapshots for lineage accounting
target.body:
## Stack dependency

This is slice 2 of 15. It follows [Feature/Fix: Add a shadow lineage ledger for Codex token accounting](https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2140); review and merge that PR first.

## Summary

Adds the first scanner adapter for the planned lineage-ledger rearchitecture. The existing fast, cancellation-aware JSONL scan now produces raw complete token observations alongside its legacy cumulative snapshots, then adapts that parsed evidence into `CodexLineageLedger.Document` values.

This is a stacked PR on top of [the shadow ledger foundation](https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2140). It does not run the ledger from production discovery and does not change published totals.

## Details

- Reuses one `CostUsageJsonl` pass; no second rollout parser
- Preserves canonical filename ownership, metadata session identity, and fork-parent identity
- Preserves complete raw `(last_token_usage, total_token_usage)` observations
- Keeps incomplete states available to the legacy snapshot path while excluding them from the ledger contract
- Propagates cancellation
- Leaves malformed timestamp policy to the mapped conservative-evidence slice

## Validation

- `swift test --filter CodexLineageLedgerTests` — 9 tests passed
- `make check`
- `SDKROOT=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Platforms/MacOSX.platform/Developer/SDKs/MacOSX26.5.sdk make test` — all 639 selections passed across 54 groups with no retries or timeouts
- Repository review gate: no material findings

Tracks [Feed the fast parser into typed rollout documents](https://github.com/iam-brain/CodexBar/issues/12).

Related investigation: [steipete/CodexBar#2037](https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/issues/2037).

target.title: Fix PTY deadline output drain
target.body:
## Summary
- drain non-Codex PTY output for a bounded settle window before returning a deadline result
- treat PTY closure as terminal enough to request the child exit status
- add a regression that preserves OAuth prompt output when the initial deadline poll misses it

Fixes #2134

## Tests
- `swift test --filter TTYCommandRunnerEnvTests`
- `swift test --skip-build --no-parallel --filter '(^CodexBarTests\.ClaudeEducationAvailabilityTests/|^CodexBarTests\.ClaudeExtraWindowQuotaWarningTests/|^CodexBarTests\.ClaudeLoginFlowTests/|^CodexBarTests\.ClaudeLoginRunnerTests/)'`
- `make check`
- `swift test --filter AdaptiveRefreshTimerTests` (fails in `AdaptiveRefreshTimerTests.swift`: `menu open advances a long idle timer during refresh without postponing an earlier tick` reports `CancellationError`; outside the touched PTY files)
- `make test` (fails in the same `AdaptiveRefreshTimerTests` case above)

## Notes
This only changes the non-Codex PTY completion path. The extra drain window is bounded to 0.2-0.5s and runs without sending input, so it can preserve late-readable output without changing the browser/auth probing behavior.
